build_nag_optimizer: build a NAG optimizer instance with params, learning rate, momentum, and weight decay settings
create_fairseq_nag_optimizer: create a FairseqNAG optimizer from a DictConfig and model parameters for training
run_nag_optimization_step: run a single NAG optimization step with optional closure to reevaluate the model and return loss
review_nag_config_dataclass: review the FairseqNAGConfig dataclass to understand momentum, weight decay, and learning rate defaults
test_nag_fp16_support: test the NAG optimizer step method with float16 or bfloat16 parameters for memory efficient training
